copy.html:
What is the Lotto America Lottery?

The Lotto America started in November 2017 and is one of the lottery games run by the the Multi-State Lottery Association, the same group that brings the massively popular US Powerball and MegaMillions. Draws are held every Monday, Wednesday and Saturday. Will you hit the jackpot?

Can I play Lotto America online?

Buying Lotto America tickets online can be done in a matter of minutes. Simply visit the LottosOnline website, select the Lotto America, choose your lucky numbers and keep your fingers crossed! It's simple, easy and 100% secure.

When is the cut off time for purchasing tickets?

The deadline for ticket purchases on LottosOnline is approximately three hours before the actual draw takes place, so no later than 8pm (Eastern Time) on the days of the draw. If you don't want to miss out, make sure you purchase you tickets in advance.

How do I win the Lotto America?

To play the game, you need to select five numbers, ranging from 1 to 52, and a Star Ball number ranging from 1 to 10. To win the jackpot you need to match five main numbers and the Star Ball.

How much can I win?

The Lotto America jackpot starts at a solid $2-Million, and rolls over for every draw where it is not won

How do I find out if I'm a winner?

Whether you've won a few dollars or hit the jackpot, LottosOnline will notify you via email. Alternatively you can check the LottosOnline website for the latest results. Why wait to hear the good news?

How do I claim the money on LottosOnline if I win the jackpot?

Not sure how to get your hands on your new fortune? Don't worry, when you win big with LottosOnline claiming your winnings is easy. After LottosOnline has verified your numbers, your winnings will reflect in your online Winnings Balance. From there, you can request a transfer to a bank account, or convert it to credit in your Account Balance for future games.

If you're a jackpot winner, we'll get in touch to discuss your requirements and make arrangements for you to collect your winning ticket.
